At QuantaSec, we provide state-of-the-art Access Control and Time Attendance solutions designed to secure and streamline your facility. Our systems support card-based access, biometric authentication (fingerprint, facial), and mobile-based entry for maximum flexibility and security.
We offer seamless integration with HR and payroll systems to ensure accurate time tracking and workforce management. Our visitor management module enables you to manage, track, and restrict access to your premises effectively—enhancing both safety and operational efficiency.
Whether you need to monitor employee attendance, restrict unauthorized access, or manage visitor entry, our scalable access solutions can be tailored to meet the needs of residential, commercial, and industrial facilities.
Biometric, RFID, and mobile-based access options.
